changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Chemin matérialisé et nature (espace ou dossier) des nœuds, calculés pour l'existant.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD COLUMN chemin VARCHAR(4000)
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD COLUMN nature VARCHAR(10)

WITH RECURSIVE arbre(id, chemin) AS ( SELECT id, '/' || id::text || '/' FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT n.id, a.chemin || n.id::text || '/' FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud n JOIN arbre a ON n.parent_id = a.id) UPDATE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud n SET chemin = a.chemin FROM arbre a WHERE a.id = n.id
UPDATE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud SET nature = CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 'ESPACE' ELSE 'DOSSIER' END
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ALTER COLUMN chemin SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ALTER COLUMN nature SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD CONSTRAINT uk_noeud_chemin UNIQUE (chemin)
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD CONSTRAINT ck_noeud_nature CHECK ((nature = 'ESPACE') = (parent_id IS NULL))
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud ADD CONSTRAINT ck_noeud_chemin CHECK (chemin ~ ('/' || id::text || '/$'))
CREATE INDEX idx_noeud_chemin ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud (chemin text_pattern_ops)

changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Déclencheurs de maintien du chemin matérialisé.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_id ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_noeud_chemin_enfants AFTER UPDATE OF chemin ON ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ${database.defaultSchemaName}.noeud_chemin_enfants()
